:::{#exr-lik-iid}
#### Likelihood of an independent sample

For [mutually independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt)
data $\dsn{X}$,
write the [likelihood](#def-lik) $\Lik(\param)$
in terms of the distributions of the individual $\Rvar_\iobs$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-lik-iid}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Lik(\param)
&\eqdef \p(\Rvar_1 = \rvar_1, \ldots, \Rvar_n = \rvar_n \mid \param)
&& \text{(definition of likelihood)}\\
&= \prodin \p(\Rvar_\iobs = \rvar_\iobs \mid \param)
&& \text{(definition of mutual independence)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
